items.lang|block_factorys_bosses|item.block_fa: §9Hook yourself to block, or an entity to yourself.
items.lang|block_factorys_bosses|message.block: The Dragon Tower is protected by ancient magic!
items.lang|bookshelf|font.minecraft.alt.desc: A rune based font associated with enchanting and magic.
items.lang|bookshelf|font.minecraft.illageralt: A mysterious font used by the illagers.
items.lang|bookshelf|font.minecraft.uniform.de: A plain font that is not stylized.
items.lang|bookshelf|tooltips.bookshelf.loot.u: Some drops can not be displayed right now.
items.lang|bookshelf|tooltips.bookshelf.loot.e: It's possible for nothing to drop!

items.lang|chloride|chloride.performance.fastc:
Replaces chests model with a solid block models with no animations.

This option has no effect when EBE and Flywheel is installed in favor of their own optimizations.
items.lang|chloride|chloride.performance.fastb: Replaces bed models with solid block models. Might break modded beds
items.lang|chloride|chloride.general.screen.de:
WINDOWED - Game is shown in a window.
BORDERLESS - Game is shown in "Windowed" mode without borders and expanded to max screen size without readjust resolution. 
FULLSCREEN - the game will display in native fullscreen mode, readjusting screen resolution to game settings
items.lang|chloride|chloride.interface.fps.des: Shows the FPS overlay. Advanced mode shows minimum FPS, as well as 30 second average FPS, useful for judging performance.
items.lang|chloride|chloride.interface.fps.sys: Shows RAM and GPU usage next to the FPS counter
items.lang|chloride|chloride.interface.fps.ali: Horizontal position of the FPS display
Vertical position of the FPS display
items.lang|chloride|chloride.interface.fps.mar: Horizontal offset of the FPS display
Vertical offset of the FPS display
items.lang|chloride|chloride.interface.fps.sha: Add a Shadow box into the FPS text, at the pure style of F3 text
items.lang|chloride|chloride.interface.languag: Language updates only reload language instead of all resources, a 99.9% extra of speed
items.lang|chloride|chloride.interface.borderl:
ATTACH - Adds borderless in the cycle
REPLACE - Replaces Fullscreen with Borderless Fullscreen
OFF - Doesn't add borderless to the cycle
items.lang|chloride|chloride.interface.font.sh:
If disabled, text will stop rendering shadows giving a flat style.
Increases FPS depending of how much text is on the screen, specially with BetterF3 mods
items.lang|chloride|chloride.interface.jei.des: Hides JEI/REI/EMI item list unless you search something. Type space to show it without searching
items.lang|chloride|chloride.interface.jei.hin: Hides JEI/REI/EMI search hint message that appears when hiding the item list
items.lang|chloride|chloride.world.blueband.de: If disabled, removed the Blue Band effect in all dimensions
items.lang|chloride|chloride.world.fog.desc: If disabled, removed fog effect only in the overworld
Configure the start of the fog
Configure the end of the fog
Configure the shape of the fog
items.lang|chloride|chloride.world.clouds.heig: RAISES CLOUD HEIGHT must be replaced with a local joke, of a meme, or something funny in your language

Raises cloud height.
Configure the height of the clouds, has no effect for happy ghasts
items.lang|chloride|chloride.world.leaves_cull: Reduces the number of leaves visible faces of the same type, Controls the depth of the culling
items.lang|chloride|chloride.world.fade.desc: If enabled, chunks will fade in when loading.
items.lang|chloride|chloride.darkness.level.de: Makes darkness more darker, making darkness attenuation more intense.
items.lang|chloride|chloride.darkness.others.d:
True darkness will be applied in other dimensions

[WARNING] This option will be removed in a near future in favor of a blacklist
items.lang|chloride|chloride.darkness.overworl: If enabled, true darkness will be applied in the Overworld.
items.lang|chloride|chloride.darkness.noskylig: If enabled, true darkness will be applied on dimensions without skylight
items.lang|chloride|chloride.darkness.fullbrig: If enabled, true darkness will be applied on biomes that provide full brightness (specially modded biomes like Alex's Caves)
items.lang|chloride|chloride.darkness.nether.d: If enabled, true darkness will be applied in the Nether.
items.lang|chloride|chloride.darkness.nether.b: Configure fog brightness in the Nether when darkness is enabled.
items.lang|chloride|chloride.darkness.end.desc: If enabled, true darkness will be applied in the End.
items.lang|chloride|chloride.darkness.end.brig: Configure fog brightness in the End when darkness is enabled.
items.lang|chloride|chloride.darkness.blocklig: If enabled, Disables sky, fog and moon brightness, making blocks as a only source of light
items.lang|chloride|chloride.darkness.moonphas: If enabled, Darkness will be affected by Moon Phases
Configure brightness on a new moon, or minimal bright level on black moon phase
Configure brightness on a full moon, or maximum bright level on black moon phase
items.lang|chloride|chloride.particles.rain.de: Enables the water falling particles when raining
items.lang|chloride|chloride.particles.rain.dr: Enables the water drop in floor particles of the rain
items.lang|chloride|chloride.particles.block.c: Enables the block cracking particles when breaking blocks
items.lang|chloride|chloride.particles.block.d: Enables the block breaking particles when breaking blocks
Disable it prevents nametag rendering for all Players
Disable it prevents nametag rendering for all Entities
Disable it prevents nametag rendering for Items, including items inside item frames
If enabled, Entities will be hidden based on configured distance limit
Hides and does not tick entities beyond this many blocks. Huge performance increase, especially around modded farms.
Hides and does not tick entities underneath this many blocks, improving performance above caves. This should ideally be set lower than the horizontal distance.
If enabled, Monsters (hostile entities) will be hidden based on configured distance limit
Hides and does not tick monsters beyond this many blocks. Huge performance increase, especially around XP farms.
Hides and does not tick monsters underneath this many blocks, improving performance above caves. This should ideally be set lower than the horizontal distance.
If enabled, Block Entities will be hidden based on configured distance limit
Hides block entities beyond this many blocks. Huge performance increase, especially around lots of modded machines.

Hides block entities underneath this many blocks, improving performance above caves (if you have your machines in caves, for some reason). This should ideally be set lower than the horizontal distance.
items.lang|chloride|chloride.zoom.desc: Turns on Zoom feature, can be activated by pressing
items.lang|chloride|chloride.zoom.max.desc: Sets maximum zoom possible using mouse wheel
